title: Keep values at or above a minimum
prompt: Write `atLeast(values: number[], minimum: number): number[]`. Return a new array of the values that are at least `minimum`, in their original order, duplicates included. Do not change `values`.
hints: Start with an empty output list.
Test each value against the threshold.
Add qualifying values as you encounter them.
checks: (() => { const input = [1, 4]; const output = atLeast(input, 4); return output !== input && __same(input, [1, 4]); })()
feedback: Start with an empty output list.
